meta.name: deepseek-acp
meta.description: DeepSeek tier: extends base-acp only. No access to real $HOME/.claude - session/project state relocated to $HOME/.claude-deepseek via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Own /tmp/deepseek-tmp root via CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR. Credential injected via nono's phantom-token proxy - agent only ever sees a placeholder value; real key lives only in nono's own credential resolution via DEEPSEEK_REAL_KEY, never in the agent's environment. Network + credential policy now both live here; settings.json.tmpl only supplies the repo path.
